# P026 Pawsfect operating-readiness evidence gate

This packet turns the seven existing P003 launch requirements into one strict,
public-safe status record. It does not buy insurance, review a contract, prove
capacity, activate a processor, inspect an inbox, authorize a booking or make
paid care launch-ready.

The native source remains `jordanistan/PawfectWalks`. The template is bound to
native commit `ea5e02497e9b5d846be3e19e6ab18b68970114e3`, which contains the
existing launch notes and the current public pre-launch/inquiry boundaries.
Update that pin deliberately after any reviewed native change.

## Required order

1. **Insurance and CCC — issue #39:** privately confirm an in-force policy for
   the actual approved operating and worker model, including care, custody or
   control and any applicable driving exposure. A quote is not coverage.
2. **Service area and availability — issue #40:** approve one initial zone,
   genuine capacity, travel buffers and private primary/backup coverage.
3. **Intake and meet-and-greet — issue #41:** approve restricted intake,
   acceptance criteria, access controls and a synthetic rehearsal.
4. **Handling and transportation — issue #42:** approve and rehearse weather,
   escape, injury, no-access and explicit transportation boundaries.
5. **Service agreement — issue #43:** obtain appropriate qualified review,
   owner approval and a private signature/copy process.
6. **Cancellation and refunds — issue #44:** approve one policy aligned across
   the agreement, invoices and support process, then rehearse it.
7. **Payment and booking controls — issue #45:** privately activate an
   owner-controlled processor and verify receipt, refund, settlement and
   reconciliation behavior before enabling collection.

The validator enforces the reviewed dependencies and chronology. A `verified`
status is still a public owner attestation—not proof that a reviewer, policy,
agreement, processor or private record exists. Independently inspect the
private evidence before relying on it.

## Public/private boundary

GitHub may contain only the fixed gate status, allowed reviewer-role label,
timestamp, boolean private-evidence marker and fixed neutral note. Never commit
policy or quote numbers, insurer documents, legal advice, signed agreements,
customer or dog records, addresses, access instructions, medical information,
worker records, processor identifiers, payment data, receipts or private
evidence references.

P026 can mark the seven P003 operating requirements complete only after every
gate is verified in order and Jordan records an offset-aware, non-future
approval timestamp after the final gate. It
permanently keeps commercial hosting, public inquiry receipt, go-live,
bookings, payment collection, recruiting and paid-care launch authorization
false. Those require separate authenticated evidence, P015 where walkers are
used, a final go/no-go decision and per-client acceptance.

## Validation

```bash
python3 -m unittest portfolio.test_pawsfect_launch -v
python3 portfolio/pawsfect_launch.py
```

Start from `P026_LAUNCH_EVIDENCE_TEMPLATE.json` only after Jordan has reviewed
the matching private evidence. Keep the filled private record outside public
GitHub and publish only a sanitized status update that passes this validator.
